name: Lifast
description_en:
Lifast is a product in the Social media management category. Its directory profile covers Posts Scheduling, Auto Publishing, Analytics (Social Media).

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business. API support is listed as Not available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $19.00. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

review_notes: Original bilingual descriptions summarize structured third-party facts; not owner or platform verification.

community_follow_up.reason_en: Actual homepage, product workflow landing, terms and privacy read. Marketing and testimonials alone not counted as completed operational research.
